notes.title: Winter Sale discount and end of the year recap
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This year is coming to an end so we wanted to recap what has happened with the game after its release:

We improved the hint system
Made it possible to play the game with just your mouse
Changed some puzzles based on your recommendations
Introduced trading cards and emoticons
Optimized every level, by reducing texture sizes and polygon density
Greatly improved the Russian, French and German translations with the help of some remarkable community members
And of course fixed numerous bugs, from saving issues to mysteriously appearing items


We feel that the game has reached a state that we are content with and decided to focus our attention on porting it to other platforms. Hopefully we will have more info on this early next year.

Apart from this, we also started to outline the next episode in the Gordian Rooms series, we have great plans!

If you haven't played the game yet, this is the perfect time to do so, as it is 20% off during the Winter Sale!

Thank you for playing our game and we would really appreciate if you could leave a review.

We sincerely hope that you have a wonderful holiday season and a Merry Christmas!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: Trading cards are here for Gordian Rooms!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are delighted to let you know that Steam trading cards have been added to the game and along with this other community features have been unlocked as well, you can now:

 Include the game in your Game Collector showcase.
 Display in-game items in the "Item Collector" and "Items To Trade" showcases.
 Display game achievements in your Achievement Showcase.

Plus, from now on the game counts towards your Achievement and Game collector badge on Steam.

There are six cards for you to collect and here are the emoticons you can unlock:

Earlier this week we uploaded a small patch that fixed a peculiar bug in the Study and we also made it possible for the telephone puzzle in the Lounge to accept another solution based on your feedback.

Thank you for playing our game!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: 1.03 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is the latest update for Gordian Rooms:

 The German translation has been completely reworked thanks to the wonderful work of glaeser.d
 Fixed some typos in the French translation
 Added a counter for the HINT system, now it should be easier to understand why a hint doesn’t change and wheter there are more helpful hints
 Added a dedicated back button for all camera scenes so now you can use this as well as the right mouse click
 Added a dedicated menu button, with this you can truly play through the game with just a mouse
 Added key combinations to skip between levels (reasons outlined below)
 Made several optimizations to the game so it should run better on lower end systems


Unfortunately the save system is not very stable and after each update some players reported that their save files were corrupted. This happened to a very small subset of players but it still pains us. So far we have been trying to fix all these issues on a case by case basis, but we realized that it would be much easier to add a shortcut to the game. 
So in case your save file happens to be corrupted after the update you can start a new game and just press one of the following key combinations to instantly get to a certain level:

CTRL+SHIFT+ALT+B → Basement
CTRL+SHIFT+ALT+K → Kitchen
CTRL+SHIFT+ALT+L → Lounge
CTRL+SHIFT+ALT+S → Study

Obviously people can abuse this system but we see little merit in doing so. This is specifically for those cases when you were at the end of the level and you don’t want to replay it because you lost your save game. This way you can continue playing without issues.

You still need to collect the horseshoes and secret messages yourself though! 
These are not stored in the save file so it doesn’t matter if your save got corrupted or not.

Again, this issue happens to only a small amount of players and it is quite possible that even after updating your save files will be intact and playable, this should be the default case. 
However, if something went wrong now there is an instantaneous solution. All you need to do is start a new game and hit the one of key combinations outlined above. 

Naturally, we would love to just resolve the save issues but it is simply impossible due to the nature of the error. That is why we came up with this fix. 

For the next game in the Gordian Rooms series we plan on completely rewriting the save system to an automatic one, all the while bearing in mind the issues of this one. Right now we are actively working on developing the game for other platforms like iOS, Android and the Nintendo Switch. We plan on starting the development of the next game after we are done with these.

We read every one of your comments, reviews and we are glad that you seem to like the game. 
Thank you for your kind reviews and we hope to do much more in the future!
Crimsonite Team

notes.title: 1.02 Update

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce that the French translation has been completely reworked thanks to the awesome effort of Dilou34. Those of you who wanted to play the game in French will have a much better time from now!

Additional fixes:

 Fixed an issue that could happen when players saved and exited from the inventory screen

Crimsonite Team

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to bring you some fixes and tweaks to the game.

Firstly, the Russian translation has been drastically improved, thanks to WenomJ69. 
Please enjoy!

Secondly, some other important fixes have been made:

 Fixed some typos in the English version, thanks for Dohi64 for bringing it to our attention
 Updated the Minimum system requirements, now they reflect the actual demands of the game much better like being compatible with Windows 7
 Fixed a bug in kitchen with the rotating dish stack
 Fixed the bug with the piano lid
 The pool balls now have a more accurate description to aid those who find it difficult to distinguish between the colors, we also tweaked the three picture clues with this in mind.
 Fixed an Oculus startup issue
 Clicking on items overrides any currently displayed message now
 You can scroll in the inventory by scrolling the mouse scroll now


PS: We enabled hints in the Study, so it should be a little easier now!

Thank you for your feedback and enjoy the game!

Crimsonite Team
